daily.today_energy: The scales are finding their balance today, Libra. There's a gentle pull toward authenticity—lean into conversations that feel real instead of performed. Your vibe is magnetic when you stop trying so hard.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the quiet confidence you've been building. Whether you're coupled or solo, today's about recognizing your own worth first. That's the energy that attracts everything else.
daily.career: Trust the ideas brewing in your head, even if they seem unconventional. Your creative instincts are sharp right now. Share that perspective—the right people are listening.
daily.health: Your body's asking for intentional movement today. Nothing intense; just something that makes you feel present. Stretch, walk, dance—whatever brings you back to your physical self.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about recalibrating your boundaries, Libra. You're naturally inclined to keep the peace, but the cosmos is gently nudging you to prioritize what actually serves your soul. Trust your gut.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering secrets about vulnerability this week. Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's real magic in showing up as your authentic self. Stop overthinking the vibe—it's already there.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are firing on all cylinders right now. This is the week to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or take that project in a bold new direction. Your unique perspective is literally your superpower.
weekly.health: Your nervous system could use some intentional rest. Whether that's meditation, long walks, or just giving yourself permission to do less—honor what your body's actually asking for right now. You deserve that.
